TLS 1.3 client and server handshake logic with X25519, Ed25519, HKDF, and alert handling.

# Purpose
This C file implements the core TLS 1.3 handshake logic for both client and server roles. It defines the `fd_tls_t` object setup functions, handshake state objects, transcript hash handling, key derivation with HKDF and HMAC, and message creation and parsing for `ClientHello`, `ServerHello`, `EncryptedExtensions`, `Certificate`, `CertificateVerify`, and `Finished`. The code also handles TLS alert generation and maps alert and reason codes to text strings for error reporting.

The file provides the main public handshake entry points [`fd_tls_server_handshake`](<#fd_tls_server_handshake>) and [`fd_tls_client_handshake`](<#fd_tls_client_handshake>), which advance each handshake state machine based on the current state, incoming record, and encryption level. It also includes support for X25519 key exchange, Ed25519 certificate signatures, optional ALPN negotiation, optional QUIC transport parameters, and raw public key or X.509 certificate handling.
